items.text:
------------------------------------------------------------------ Accent
A single accent colour, in terracotta. It serves exactly three things:
the primary action, the current selection, the focus ring. Never
decorative.
Private browsing, storage blocked: the system theme will do.

Actions revealed on hover, but always reachable by keyboard:
            `focus-within` makes them visible as soon as one takes focus.
Nook — local-first note taking. Your data stays encrypted on your machine.
